$comment: Bundled defaults for shell verbs the approval gate auto-allows when invoked inside a trusted zone (per-audience trustedZones + session_dir + audience baseline). Each entry is a verb chain matched by exact equality against the shell parser's verb-chain extraction. Inclusion bar: a verb is listed only if it cannot write or delete files, cannot execute arbitrary code, and cannot POST/PATCH/DELETE to a network endpoint. Mutating verbs are intentionally absent — git push, git fetch, git tag, gh api, awk -i inplace, sed -i etc. still prompt. sed is pinned to its read-only -n flag form. Command-prefixing verbs (env, xargs, sudo, timeout, nohup) are intentionally absent — they would let an arbitrary command inherit the auto-pass. This list is immutable at runtime: no on-disk override file is read. Widening the list goes through code review and a daemon release so the agent cannot extend its own auto-pass surface via file writes.
